description:
## 1.36.0-dev.106 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: remove the laggy custom Compose comment scanner and selection overlay.
- Reddit: restore the stable native post-detail keyboard navigation used before dev100.
- Reddit: make O walk the currently focused native Compose node and invoke only its labeled Collapse or Expand action.
- Reddit: leave P and media preview handling unchanged from dev105.
